verdict.rationale: Databricks ships built-in AI assistants (Genie Code for coding/data work, Genie for natural-language BI queries) that users can delegate tasks to directly inside the workspace — generating/running code, building pipelines and dashboards, debugging errors, and even running as an autonomous agent that plans, executes, fixes errors and asks approval before tool use. This is well documented across multiple first-party docs pages, though there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of the assistant's real-world reliability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of assistant quality/reliability, community corroboration of the delegation experience.
